siege.name: Siege
siege.text: The planet is half poisoned. The creatures smell the rot and converge on the colony. What now?

endure.label: Hold the line
endure.text: Raids grow more frequent and stronger for a few days.

appease.label: Pay off with essence
appease.text: The wardens take refined essence and hold the planet back: taint drops and raids are delayed.

dead_lands.name: Dead Lands
dead_lands.text: The map edges have turned toxic. Colonists outside the safe zone fall ill.

evacuate.label: Evacuate the stockpile
evacuate.text: A third of the stockpiled ore and waste is lost, but the borders stay safe.

endure.label: Endure the poison
endure.text: The map outskirts stay toxic for the rest of the game: anyone who goes there falls ill.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.text: The planet is dying. Halt refining, or squeeze out everything it has left?

halt.label: Halt refining
halt.text: Refining is locked for a few days.

overdrive.label: Overdrive
overdrive.text: Double the essence per batch, but taint grows three times faster.
